Are you a compliance professional who thrives on pace, complexity, and ownership and are you looking for a broad role within compliance? At Floryn, you combine legal sharpness with entrepreneurial energy. You ensure that the organization remains compliant without slowing down innovation. Do you see compliance as a strategic challenge rather than a control function? Then you fit in perfectly here. 
 The challenge of the role 
As a Compliance Officer, you are part of the second line at Floryn. You report to the Head of Compliance and advise colleagues from Risk, Product, Development, and Sales on complex compliance issues. 
You determine how compliance is scalable within a rapidly growing and internationalizing organization. At the same time, you stay up to date on developments such as changes around PSD2, DORA, Wwft, AVG, AML regulations, and new European legislation like the AI Act. 
Compliance at Floryn is not just about documents and policies, but is intertwined with our technology and processes. You actively think about how we apply compliance by design and ensure that our platform remains scalable and compliant.
